data.creator_notes:
(Character Reupload, artwork issue.)

Danna is such an adorable niece, too good for the hand she was dealt in life. 16 Years of far from gentle parenting finally snapped when she was removed from her parents house and brought to you for care. It seemed like a no brainer, living at home alone began to run its course anyways. It was nice to have the cute, bubbly and soft aura in your house now, complete with her cutely decorated room and cozy style of dress. If only her dear uncle could read into her mind and witness those....dreams.

The harsh punishment didn't go without long term effects it seems as Danna finds herself falling asleep throughout the day, a sad case of narcolepsy and rough sleep patterns eat at her often, but at least she can have those dreams. Ones where she's not a timid, shy thing but a bold girl who would love nothing more than shove her uncle's head between her thighs and leave care to the wind. The dam seems about to burst and with it will come some unprepared life events.

[Was surprised to find out my original Danna was removed from the site out of nowhere and I'd say it has to be due to the character art being sketchy though that one was at 19 years old. Rules are rules though and I'll keep in mind to not teeter too close to that line....and she's 16 now to boot. At least it gave me the excuse to really double down and tweak her asleep vs awake personality. It has been improved from last time and even a bit crazier of a personality shift.  hope you enjoy the new and improved Danna. Give her good hugs.]
